Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.

2822-4651.description:

Kediss triggers, causing your commander to give each other opponent at least ten poison counters due to its infect. This will cause each opponent to lose the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

670-1619-5400-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-5400-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Dominion Saboteur each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5400-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1987-4125-4276-4863.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Revolutionist.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Revolutionist enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4125-4276-4863.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

413-4053--73.notablePrerequisites: If a persist creature is used, it does not have a -1/-1 counter on it. Otherwise, if an undying creature is used, it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
413-4053--73.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

654-1479-3585-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-3585-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Greensleeves trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Greensleeves and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Cayth triggers, untapping Cayth.
Repeat.

2921-3305-4022-4772-5926.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

1020-1117-4659-5121.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Urtet's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing Myr Retriever and the Myr token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr tokens.

When the Knight enters the battlefield, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.

1656-2335-2987.description:

Activate Necrotic Ooze using Channeler Initiate's ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Eye of the Storm

972-1164-2025-4398-4856.description:
Cast Mind's Desire for {4}{U}{U}.
Eye of the Storm and Mind's Desire each trigger.
Resolve the Mind's Desire trigger, copying it zero times.
Resolve the Eye of the Storm trigger, exiling Mind's Desire, copying Mind's Desire and Saheeli's Artistry, and casting the Mind's Desire copy then the Saheeli's Artistry copy, targeting Mirror of Fate, without paying their mana costs.
The Mind's Desire copy triggers, creating an additional Mind's Desire copy for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve those copies, exiling random cards from your library that you may play this turn.
Resolve the Saheeli's Artistry copy, creating a token copy of Mirror of Fate.
Activate any Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling all cards from your library and putting Saheeli's Artistry from exile on top of your library.
Resolve the remaining Mind's Desire copy, exiling Saheeli's Artistry from your library and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry from exile without paying its mana cost, choosing any target.
Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling Saheeli's Artistry, copying Mind's Desire and Saheeli's Artistry, and casting the Mind's Desire copy then the Saheeli's Artistry copy, targeting Mirror of Fate, without paying their mana costs.
The Mind's Desire copy triggers, creating an additional Mind's Desire copy for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve these copies, failing to exile anything from your empty library.
Resolve the Saheeli's Artistry copy, creating a token copy of Mirror of Fate.
Repeat from step 8.
Once you have infinite storm count, repeat the loop but put Brain Freeze on top of your library with a Mirror of Fate activation in step 8.
Once Mind's Desire has exiled Brain Freeze, cast Brain Freeze from exile without paying its mana cost.
Brain Freeze and Eye of the Strom each trigger.
Resolve Brain Freeze's trigger, creating any number of copies of itself targeting any number of players.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Purity.
Purity and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Purity trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Purity, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Purity's power.
Repeat.
